INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Presentation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Presentation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Presentation.

4. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.

5. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

9. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

10. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.

11. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.

12. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
